start.hub.title: Pappy — your Telegram media assistant
start.hub.body: Send me anything — a song name, movie title, link, photo, or voice note.
start.hub.hint: Tip: just type what you want. No commands to memorize.
error.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
music.search.prompt: Tell me what to find — e.g. `/music Lithe`.
music.results.title: Results for “{q}”
music.error.title: ❌ No results
music.error.body: Nothing found for “{q}”. Check the spelling or try artist + title.
music.session.expired: This result expired — search again to get fresh buttons.
music.download.noSource: The source didn't expose a downloadable page for this item.
music.download.gated: The source withheld media URLs on this network. Try another result.
music.download.tooLarge: File is {mb} MB — too large for this upload route.
music.queue.soon: Playlists ship in the next slice — download works today.
music.url.soon: Link downloads land in the next slice — today I search music. Try a song name.
url.gallery.title: 🔗 {p}
url.gallery.capped: Showing the first {shown} of {total} — batches cap at 25.
url.invalid: That does not look like a link I can open.
url.unsupported: I can't open that link yet — I support the big social + video platforms.
url.gated: That link needs a login I don't have — the source kept it behind auth.
url.restricted: The source refused that link (private, removed, or region-locked).
lib.playlists.title: 📋 Playlists
lib.playlist.empty: Empty — tap ❤ Save on any track to fill it.
lib.favs.title: ❤ Favorites
lib.favs.empty: No favorites yet — tap ❤ on any track.
lib.history.title: 🕘 History
fj.title: 🔐 One step first
fj.body: This bot is served alongside these channels — join them, then tap Verify. Your request is saved.
fj.still_missing: Still missing — join every channel above, then Verify again.
fj.expired: That request expired — send it again.
fj.banned: 🚫 This account is banned from the bot.
set.title: ⚙️ Settings
set.quality_note: Quality is saved and will apply when variant downloads land; today sources serve their default.
set.lang_note: English only for now — more languages with V1.5.
own.title: 🛠 Owner console
hub.hint.music: Type any song or artist name and I will search.
hub.hint.url: Paste any video or post link and I will fetch it.
hub.hint.soon: Not in V1 — music search + link downloads work today. Try those.
fj.inline_ready: ✅ Verified — use me inline in any chat now!
stream.dm: 🎧 Streams live in groups — use /play in the flagged group.
stream.not_enabled: 🎧 Streaming is not enabled in this group yet (alpha).
stream.need_admin: 🔒 Only group admins can control playback.
stream.offline: 🔌 The stream worker is offline — try again in a minute.
stream.no_source: ❌ Found it, but no playable audio surfaced — skipping.
stream.empty: The queue is empty — /play <song> to start.
stream.queue.title: 🎧 Queue
stream.stale: That button expired — use the latest card.
